subject: Cognitive Science
title: Language and Identity
description: A 60-second lesson on Language and Identity.

hook.text: Bilinguals report feeling like a different person in each language. Their personality test scores actually shift.

buildup.text: Researchers found bilinguals are more assertive in one language and more polite in another—consistently.

discovery.text: Each language carries embedded cultural norms. Speaking the language activates that culture's social framework.

twist.text: Moral decisions shift too. Bilinguals make more utilitarian choices when reasoning in their second language.

climax.text: The emotional distance of a second language reduces gut reactions—creating cooler, more detached reasoning.

punchline.text: Change your language, change your mind.

quiz.question: What happens to moral decisions in a second language?
